name: Russell Arnold
abstract_title: The Reality of the Imaginary in Geometry
abstract: A major challenge to holistic-scientific hypotheses is the prevalence of the notion that any real entity has a location, be it in 3D space or 4D space time, sharply defined or spread out. A largely untapped mathematical approach overcoming this limitation has existed for over a century: imaginary points.
